 Order(Oral)

 02. 1.

This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/Physical Mode).
2.

This is a bail application U/S.483 of the BNSS by the petitioner for grant of bail in connection with Kantamal PS Case No.101 of 2024 arising out of ST Case No.38 of 2024 pending in the Court of learned Addl. Sessions Judge, Kantamal for commission of offences punishable U/Ss.498A/294/326/307/506/302 of IPC r/w Sec.4 of DP Act, on the main allegation of committing uxoricide by setting fire to the deceased after pouring kerosene and also subjecting her to torture and cruelty for demand of dowry.

entities.text: Court of learned Addl. Sessions Judge, Kantamal
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
3. Heard, Mr. Amitav Tripathy, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. R.B. Mishra, learned Additional Public Prosecutor in the matter and perused the record.
4.

After having considered the rival submissions and taking into consideration the nature and gravity of the offences as alleged against the petitioner vis--vis the allegation sought to be brought against him and the materials collected in support thereof and taking into account the other materials placed on record in entirety including the dying declaration of the deceased, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner at this stage.
Hence, the bail application of the petitioner stands rejected.
5. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
